note: V4 recipe B, the pre-dev note's machine half for the second recipe (docs/V4_FEASIBILITY.md, section 5c). CHOSEN AFTER SEEING RECIPE A's DEV RESULTS (2026-11-20): recipe A (configs/v4_predev.json: head co-trained at 10x the adapter lr) finished below the frozen V3 heads on both dev splits, and on the 2K dev_unseen subset its fine-tuned encoder with the ORIGINAL V3 head scored about as well as V3 while its co-trained head scored lower in all 4 runs (a post-hoc diagnostic). Recipe B is identical to A except train.freeze_head = true: the head stays the V3 bal cell_zeroshot head of the same N, only LoRA (last 12 blocks, r16) trains. Same inputs, lr grid, edge/stop rules, tie tolerance, margin, selection split, GPU parity rule. Job names carry the B_ prefix (distinct run ids and runs-repo paths from recipe A). The augmented-frozen control (recipe A job 7) is not declared: with the head frozen it has nothing to train (section 5c). Its selection file is configs/v4_selection_v2.json.
gpu_rule: job k: streetclip on cuda:(k mod 2), clip_l14_336 on the other GPU (decision 7)

train.schedule: linear warmup, then cosine to 0 (train.lr_factor); the scheduler step is skipped when an fp16 overflow skips the optimizer step
train.augmentation: train.train_view (V1: no flip, no hue), seeded by (seed, epoch, bal_rank)

evals.intermediate: 5K dev_unseen at steps total//3 and 2*total//3, full runs only (diagnostic only; short runs have none, as budgeted)
evals.diagnostic: 2K dev_unseen after every epoch boundary, in the 50K full run (job 4) only: diagnostic only, never used for selection, stopping or checkpoint choice
evals.final: all of dev_unseen (selection) and dev_seen (diagnostic), at the final checkpoint

selection.metric: mean GeoScore of the top-1 cell centroid
